name: Perfectionist
blurb: Cuts look cleaner. You walk a bit slower.

name: Speedster
blurb: You move faster. Cuts are a little rougher.

name: Early Bird
blurb: More points before 10 AM. Energy drops faster after 6 PM.

name: Night Owl
blurb: No fungus from evening water. You start the day at 70 energy.

name: Green Thumb
blurb: Seed and fertilizer work better. Weeds lower your mood.

name: Gearhead
blurb: Maintenance costs less. Hand tools tire you more.

name: Penny Pincher
blurb: Shop prices are 10% lower. Bonus coins are a bit smaller.

name: Tough Cookie
blurb: Heat waves do not extra-drain energy. Mood recovers slower.

name: Chatterbox
blurb: Neighbors tip more. Sometimes you pause to talk.
